title: Adjust Your Mock Drafts: Gladstone Hints at Draft Philosophy

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Adjust Your Mock Drafts: Gladstone Hints at Draft Philosophy
sources.description: James Gladstone made a comment at Thursday's press conference that Jaguars fans may have heard very differently, depending on how they feel about the 2025 rookie class. We take a closer look at the Jaguars GM's statement and what it could mean for Jacksonville's approach heading into April's draft.
